findings.title: Any authenticated user can download another tenant's invoice PDF
findings.control_gap: the handler loads the invoice by id only, with no tenantId predicate and no ownership check before signing the download URL (route.ts:22-27)
findings.effect: returns a signed download URL for any invoice id, including invoices belonging to other tenants
findings.reproduction: 1. sign in as a tenant B user. 2. request a tenant A invoice id. 3. receive a valid signed URL and the PDF.

evidence.note: findUnique({ where: { id } }) with no tenant predicate
signed URL returned before any ownership check

fix.summary: scope the lookup to the session tenant; 404 (not 403) to avoid confirming existence
fix.diff_or_patch:
- const inv = await db.invoice.findUnique({ where: { id } })
+ const inv = await db.invoice.findFirst({ where: { id, tenantId: session.tenantId } })
+ if (!inv) return NextResponse.json({ error: 'not found' }, { status: 404 })
fix.test: tenant B requesting a tenant A invoice id returns 404 with no download URL

findings.notes: systemic fix: a repository layer that requires a tenant argument in its type signature

findings.title: Markdown renderer allows raw HTML, enabling stored XSS in shared notes
findings.principal: any user who can create a note read by a colleague
findings.control_gap: rehypeRaw re-enables raw HTML in markdown and no sanitizer is applied to the rendered tree (Markdown.tsx:9-12)
findings.effect: an payload in a note executes in the reader's session; the session cookie is httpOnly but the app exposes an authed fetch, so data can be exfiltrated
findings.reproduction: 1. create a note containing an img tag with an onerror handler. 2. have another user open the note. 3. handler runs with the reader's session.

evidence.note: no rehype-sanitize in the plugin chain

fix.summary: drop rehypeRaw, or add rehype-sanitize with an allowlist schema
fix.test: rendering a note with an onerror attribute produces no event handler in the DOM

findings.title: Possible cross-tenant read in analytics export
findings.control_gap: the export query filters by workspaceId from the request body; whether it is compared to the session workspace depends on a helper in packages/api/src/scope.ts that reads a feature flag
findings.effect: if the flag is off, an admin could export another workspace's rows
findings.question: Is FEATURE_STRICT_WORKSPACE_SCOPE enabled in production? scope.ts falls back to the client-supplied workspaceId when it is off.

fix.summary: scope by session regardless of the flag; treat the flag as removed
fix.test: export with a foreign workspaceId in the body returns only session-scoped rows

findings.title: JWT stored in localStorage
findings.rejection_reason: the app sets a nonce-based CSP with no unsafe-inline, renders no user HTML after SR-002 is fixed, and loads no third-party scripts — reachability of the token by script is not demonstrated. Keep as defence-in-depth note, not a finding.

coverage.reason: the provider is chosen by the customer at runtime and the signing config is not in this repo
